'''Maylin''' is a serving maid at [[The Old Sheep]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Appearance==
Maylin is an exceptionally beautiful girl, however she isn't very intelligent.

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] is searching for [[Olver]], he speaks with Maylin. She, however, only tells him of confusing rumors that she has heard.{{ref/book|7|39}}
